task: Stream::prepend() and Stream::append() called with no values change the stream: Stream::of(['a' => 1, 'b' => 2])->prepend()->toAssociativeArray() loses the keys (append() too), and a stream over an array becomes single-use, so iterating Stream::of([1, 2])->prepend() a second time gives nothing. With no values both should leave the stream exactly as it was.
